title: DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer
description: We are hiring a DevOps engineer to own our cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines. You will run Kubernetes clusters on AWS, write Terraform for everything, harden CI/CD pipelines, and drive incident response and observability across services.
requirements: 5+ years in DevOps or SRE roles. Production Kubernetes operations. Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure. Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. Strong Linux administration and shell scripting. On-call experience with monitoring and alerting stacks such as Prometheus and Grafana.
requiredEducation: Bachelor degree in computer science or related field
